components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Compact, high-emphasis action using the semantic primary roles.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { height: 36px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; border: 0; border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 16px; background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / .05); font: 500 14px/20px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary) 90%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 0; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); } .ds-btn-primary:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Outline Button
components.description: Quiet secondary action with a fine semantic border.
components.css: .ds-btn-outline { height: 36px; display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 8px; padding: 8px 16px; background: var(--background); color: var(--foreground); box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / .05); font: 500 14px/20px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms ease, color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-btn-outline:hover { background: var(--accent); color: var(--accent-foreground); } .ds-btn-outline:focus-visible { outline: 0; border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); } .ds-btn-outline:active { transform: translateY(1px); }

components.name: Search Field
components.description: Compact reference search with a visible semantic focus state.
components.css: .ds-search { position: relative; display: block; width: 320px; max-width: 100%; font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-search svg { position: absolute; left: 12px; top: 50%; width: 16px; height: 16px; transform: translateY(-50%); fill: none; stroke: var(--muted-foreground); stroke-width: 2; } .ds-search input { box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; height: 40px; border: 1px solid var(--input); border-radius: 8px; padding: 4px 12px 4px 36px; background: var(--background); color: var(--foreground); font: 400 14px/20px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; outline: 0; } .ds-search input::placeholder { color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-search input:focus-visible { border-color: var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); } .ds-sr { position: absolute; width: 1px; height: 1px; overflow: hidden; clip: rect(0,0,0,0); }

components.name: Reference Card
components.description: Shared bordered card for grouped facts; dense indexes may use rule-separated rows instead.
components.html:
Mechanics

Exact game facts stay close to their label and source context.
components.css: .ds-card { display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; border: 1px solid var(--border); border-radius: 14px; padding: 16px; background: var(--card); color: var(--card-foreground); box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgb(0 0 0 / .1), 0 1px 2px -1px rgb(0 0 0 / .1); font-family: ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card h3 { margin: 0; font-size: 16px; line-height: 24px; font-weight: 600; } .ds-card p { margin: 0; color: var(--muted-foreground); font-size: 14px; line-height: 21px; } .ds-card:focus-within { border-color: var(--ring); }

components.name: Semantic Badge
components.description: Small pill for a real state or category, not free decoration.
components.css: .ds-badge { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 4px; width: fit-content; border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 2px 8px; background: var(--primary); color: var(--primary-foreground); font: 500 12px/16px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; white-space: nowrap; transition: background-color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-badge:hover { background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary) 90%, transparent); } .ds-badge:focus-visible { outline: 0; box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Compact Tabs
components.description: Muted segmented navigation with one canvas-colored active tab.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; height: 36px; border-radius: 10px; padding: 3px; background: var(--muted); color: var(--muted-foreground); } .ds-tab { height: calc(100% - 1px); border: 1px solid transparent; border-radius: 8px; padding: 4px 8px; background: transparent; color: var(--foreground); font: 500 14px/20px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: color 150ms ease, box-shadow 150ms ease; } .ds-tab.is-active { background: var(--background); box-shadow: 0 1px 3px rgb(0 0 0 / .1); } .ds-tab:hover { color: var(--foreground); } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 1px solid var(--ring); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklab, var(--ring) 50%, transparent); }

components.name: Breadcrumb
components.description: Muted route trail with a medium-weight current location.
components.css: .ds-breadcrumb { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; overflow: hidden; color: var(--muted-foreground); font: 400 14px/20px ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-breadcrumb a { color: var(--muted-foreground); text-decoration: none; transition: color 150ms ease; white-space: nowrap; } .ds-breadcrumb a:hover { color: var(--foreground); } .ds-breadcrumb a:focus-visible { border-radius: 6px; outline: 2px solid var(--ring); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-breadcrumb span { opacity: .5; } .ds-breadcrumb strong { min-width: 0; overflow: hidden; color: var(--foreground); font-weight: 500; text-overflow: ellipsis; white-space: nowrap; }

narrative.overview:
The compendium is a neutral, compact reference surface. It keeps the interface quiet so exact game facts, relationships, and exported art remain easy to scan. Dense typography, fine rules, restrained color, and small controls make the site feel like a maintained field guide rather than a promotional game site.

The achievements atlas is one expression of this system: a plain canvas, square Steam art, category rules, a narrow index, and sparse amber markers organize 38 unlock conditions without turning them into a generic card wall. Its split hero and category composition are page-specific evidence, not templates for every route.
keyCharacteristics: Neutral light and dark canvases with semantic foreground, surface, rule, and focus roles.
Dense system-sans reference typography with clear weight and size changes.
Fine borders and tonal surfaces provide most structure.
Exported game art stays square, legible, and subordinate to factual text.
Accent color is sparse and functional; links remain conventionally blue.

rules.name: The Semantic Color Rule
rules.body: Use saturated color only when it communicates a link, state, category, item quality, or interaction.

rules.name: The Theme Role Rule
rules.body: Components refer to semantic roles, never to a light-mode literal that would fail on the dark canvas.

rules.name: The Scan Before Flourish Rule
rules.body: Use weight and spacing to expose the information hierarchy. Do not introduce decorative typography that slows lookup.

rules.name: The Numeric Alignment Rule
rules.body: Counts and comparable values use tabular figures.

rules.name: The Fact Density Rule
rules.body: Keep related labels, values, and actions close; use larger gaps only between semantic groups.

rules.name: The Static-First Rule
rules.body: Responsive and content layouts remain complete in static HTML. JavaScript-only search and loading affordances are additive.

rules.name: The Flat Reference Rule
rules.body: Use rules and tonal contrast first. Add a shadow only when a control, card, or image needs separation from its immediate ground.

rules.name: The Square Artifact Rule
rules.body: Preserve exported game and Steam art at a square aspect ratio without stretching or ornamental masks.

dos: Do use semantic colors so light and dark themes preserve the same hierarchy.
Do keep exported artwork square, uncropped beyond `object-fit: cover`, and paired with factual text.
Do use fine rules, muted text, tabular counts, and compact gaps to make long reference lists scannable.
Do preserve conventional blue links for related compendium destinations.
Do let dense indexes use rows and dividers instead of forcing every entity into a card.
donts: Don't use amber, quality colors, or chart colors as general decoration outside their evidenced meanings.
Don't add heavy shadows, glass panels, gradients, or ornamental frames to ordinary reference content.
Don't stretch square game art or use it as low-contrast background decoration.
Don't promote the achievements split hero, trophy field, or oversized system-sans heading into a mandatory site-wide template.
Don't hide core facts behind JavaScript-only controls or interactions.
